fs/entry#

A path on disk, opened or not: whether something is there, what it is, and removing, moving or copying it.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let entry = FileEntry(Path("notes.txt"));
if entry.existence() {
    entry.copy(Path("notes.bak"));
    entry.move(destination: Path("notes.old"), overwrite: true);
}

Description#

A path on disk, opened or not: whether something is there, what it is, and removing, moving or copying it. Reading and writing go through fs/file.

move and copy refuse a destination that already exists (FileError.already_exists names it) unless overwrite is true. A move then replaces the destination in one step; a copy is written beside it and renamed over it, so a failed copy leaves the old file whole. A copy keeps the permission bits of its source.
